findings.text: The text says "No merge is authorized or recorded" and "Hosted acceptance is pending", but lines 220-223 say the owner merged PR 295 at 15:00 UTC, so two parts of the document contradict each other. Fix: mark the paragraph at lines 120-130 as the earlier checkpoint, or cut its merge and pending claims, and keep the merge record at line 220 as the current state.

The merge left no blank line before `## Hosted follow-up, 2026-10-28`. The conflict markers are gone, but the hosted-run paragraph at lines 127-130 now runs straight into the heading and shows no date label of its own. Fix: add a blank line before the heading and date the hosted-run paragraph.
